findings.desc: doc-promise-undelivered: packages/main/src/core/acceptance-discovery-adapters.ts:81 declares five registered discovery adapters, but buildResult assigns the same preassembled input.pathRefs to process_fact_registry, handler_dispatch_inventory, and static_call_graph, while runtime_trace performs no discovery. runAcceptanceDiscoveryAdapters only relabels this one input set; it never inspects handler/dispatch source, a static graph, or runtime facts. Because deriveAcceptanceCoverageBasis constructs input.pathRefs from the topology/planned declarations themselves, the adapters cannot independently discover an omitted path or naturally disagree and can falsely classify the self-described closure complete. This violates Wave 1A's independent registered-adapter exit condition.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by 53c949a2ec and 70e74b7b35: registered adapters now derive from separate canonical scope-contract, PROCESS_FACT_REGISTRY, handler/dispatch registry source refs, static endpoint source inspection, and bounded runtime inputs rather than relabelling topology pathRefs. Current-HEAD focused smoke proves a real omitted registered consumer is discovered/fails closed and restored control passes.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/acceptance-coverage-basis.ts:160 computes closureFilesHash from only planned endpoint files; registered producer/consumer closure entries are appended as literal inventory strings and their referenced source files are never resolved or content-hashed. deriveRegisteredProcessFactClosure likewise emits producer/consumer labels rather than resolvable source paths (acceptance-discovery-adapters.ts:44). Therefore an out-of-scope registered consumer can change while closureFilesHash remains unchanged, defeating the receipt freshness binding explicitly required by Wave 1A.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by 53c949a2ec and 70e74b7b35: closureFilesHash now resolves and hashes content for every registered producer/consumer source ref, not literal labels; any missing/uninspectable source emits a blind spot and prevents complete. Current-HEAD closure-source content drift and closure-omission mutations bite, restored control passes.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/acceptance-coverage-basis.ts:278 contains the only topology-versus-basis and exclusion validation, but neither deriveAcceptanceCoverageBasis nor the production generate/read handlers call it (handlers/proofstory.ts:134-184,206-234). Worse, derivation seeds every topology path into expectedPathRefs at lines 194-203 and the echo adapters reproduce it, so an invented topology path can be absorbed into a complete signed basis. The smoke calls reconcileTopologyWithCoverageBasis directly, which does not prove the real acceptance_basis_generate/acceptance_basis path rejects the mutation.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by 53c949a2ec: production acceptance_basis_generate and acceptance_basis verification execute topology-versus-derived-basis reconciliation before accepting complete; topology is no longer adapter seed authority. Current-HEAD production invented-topology mutation fails through generate/read while legitimate planned topology passes.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/acceptance-coverage-basis.ts:289-291 implements exclusion eligibility as only a /^decision:/ string regex. It does not resolve the decisionRef from the canonical foundational decision store/schema, verify an eligible decision kind, or detect stale/unrelated decisions as required by CHK-004 and the plan. The smoke covers only free-form prose without a decision: prefix, so decision:anything would escape AT_UNJUSTIFIED_EXCLUSION. Add canonical decision resolution and negative tests for missing, stale, unrelated, and ineligible-kind refs (or explicitly leave all exclusions unsupported/non-complete in Wave 1A).
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by 53c949a2ec: exclusion decisionRefs are resolved against canonical foundational decision artifacts with schema, eligible kind, current relevance, uniqueness and target checks; regex-only acceptance removed. Current-HEAD valid/missing/stale/unrelated/ineligible/malformed/duplicate matrix yields stable AT_UNJUSTIFIED_EXCLUSION failures and restored valid control passes.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/acceptance-coverage-basis.ts:149-156 and :201-207 do not bind the discovered global closure source contents promised by closureFilesHash. computeClosureFilesHash hashes only files named by plannedPathRecords; sourceInventory entries for PROCESS_FACT_REGISTRY producers/consumer gates are merely hashed as identifier strings and are never resolved to source files. A consumer outside Story scope can change without its file content entering closureFilesHash, violating the explicit Wave 1A requirement that every discovered producer and consumer source reference, including outside storyFilesHash, be content-bound and uninspectable consumers force partial.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by 53c949a2ec and 70e74b7b35: discovered global producer/consumer source contents are included in canonical closureFilesHash and uninspectable entries force partial. Current-HEAD source-content drift, missing-source and out-of-scope consumer omission mutations invalidate freshness/completeness; restored control passes.

findings.desc: doc-promise-undelivered: packages/main/src/core/acceptance-coverage-basis.ts:194-204 and packages/main/src/core/acceptance-discovery-adapters.ts:81-108 do not implement independently derived discovery. deriveAcceptanceCoverageBasis first takes path refs from the submitted topology/planned declarations, then buildResult copies that same precomputed set verbatim into process_fact_registry, handler_dispatch_inventory, and static_call_graph while runtime_trace contributes nothing. Consequently deleting an undeclared real handler/dispatch/static consumer from topology makes every synthetic adapter agree and can still yield status=complete; there is no repository/handler/dispatch/static/runtime inspection. This contradicts the Wave 1A exit condition and the new CLI promise that the registered profile derives the union. Implement method-specific adapters from canonical repository/runtime inputs and prove an actual omitted consumer is discovered/fails closed.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by 53c949a2ec and 70e74b7b35: discovery no longer copies topology/planned pathRefs into every adapter; method-specific registered facts and repository source inspection independently derive the union. Current-HEAD removal of a real handler/dispatch/static consumer is detected, and bounded runtime trace cannot assert exhaustive completeness.

findings.desc: CHK-001 must coverage is overclaimed: packages/main/src/tasks/proofstory-acceptance-basis-smoke.ts:235 exercises only status/enumeratedPathRefs/issuer on the read command. VI-A32A-001-CALLER-FORGERY explicitly requires every public entry point and status, enumeratedPathRefs, blindSpots, excludedPathRefs, generatedBy, and digest fields, including the direct handler boundary. No assertions cover the remaining fields, acceptance_basis_generate, or direct-handler rejection/ignore semantics, so its recorded manual_transcript is not sufficient.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by 53c949a2ec: both CLI schemas are strict and both direct handlers reject caller status, enumeratedPathRefs, blindSpots, excludedPathRefs, generatedBy and digest fields. Current-HEAD smoke covers 6 fields × 2 public commands × CLI and direct-handler boundaries, with atomic snapshots and restored controls.

findings.desc: CHK-002 must mutation coverage is incomplete: packages/main/src/tasks/proofstory-acceptance-basis-smoke.ts:139-169 covers missing/duplicate, one undigested path edit, disagreement, and aggregate removal only. VI-A32A-002-OMISSION-AND-AGGREGATE-TAMPER / VI-A32A-002-RESULT-AND-CLOSURE-TAMPER also require aggregate addition and blindSpot tamper, recomputed adapter digest retained under the old signed basis, and omission of the registered out-of-scope consumer from closure. Lines 133-135 only prove the positive closure, not the required omission mutation. Yet both intents are marked pass.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by 53c949a2ec/70e74b7b35: current-HEAD smoke now bites aggregate add/remove/blindSpot tamper, adapter-result mutation, recomputed adapter digest retained under old signed receipt, duplicate/missing adapter, disagreement, and registered consumer closure omission; every intended diagnostic is asserted and restored control passes.

findings.desc: CHK-003 must receipt/freshness coverage is incomplete: packages/main/src/tasks/proofstory-acceptance-basis-smoke.ts:239-266 mutates signature, basisDigest, storyId, workspaceIdentityDigest, scopeCheckDigest, closureFilesHash, and one closure source. It does not bite topologyDigest/version, scopeContractDigest, storyFilesHash, phaseBasis, adapter-set/result bindings, a freshly re-signed hash-only rebind, frozen topology/scope/discovery/story drift, or the legacy-missing/failed-generation no-partial-artifact/event guarantees required by VI-A32A-003-SIGNED-BOUND-RECEIPT, FRESHNESS-CLASSIFICATION, LEGACY-AND-ATOMICITY, and TAMPER-AND-HASH-REBIND. Their pass evidence therefore lacks the declared negative controls.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by 53c949a2ec: current-HEAD smoke mutates receipt schema/topology digest+version/scope-check/scope-contract/head/material/storyFiles/closure/phase/adapter-set+results/story/workspace/signature, proves re-signed hash-only rebind rejection, frozen input drift, legacy missing behavior and failed-generation no-partial-artifact/event atomicity; restored receipts verify.

findings.desc: CHK-004/005 strict coverage is incomplete: packages/main/src/tasks/proofstory-acceptance-basis-smoke.ts:174-186 tests deletion, one invented existing ref, free-form exclusion prose, and invalid file only. It does not retain declaration IDs while drifting endpoint role/artifact/file/symbol/relation/output fact, nor test valid vs malformed/stale/duplicate/unrelated/ineligible-kind decisionRefs as required by the frozen plan and VI-A32A-004-*. Lines 218-237 exercise JSON reads only and snapshot only artifact after invalid input, not text rendering plus full story/events/git/lifecycle atomicity; verify-process-fact-contract is only run green, with no one-sided registration mutation required by VI-A32A-005-PROCESS-FACT-CONTRACT. VI-A32A-005-MUTATION-CAMPAIGN and READONLY-DIAGNOSTIC-BOUNDARY consequently overstate coverage.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by 53c949a2ec: current-HEAD smoke covers retained-ID drift of endpoint role/artifact/file/symbol/relation/outputFact; full decisionRef validity matrix; text and JSON reads with Story/receipt/events/phase/git/lifecycle snapshots; production mutation campaign; and a one-sided process-fact contract mutation that fails before restored contract PASS.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/acceptance-discovery-adapters.ts:164-180 still does not implement an independently enumerating handler/dispatch inventory or static call graph: both adapters iterate only closure.entries already selected from PROCESS_FACT_REGISTRY using planned-path seeds, then use substring presence to mark each known entry inspectable. runAcceptanceDiscoveryAdapters at lines 210-214 supplies no checklist/scope file inventory, so an unregistered handler/consumer (or any Story with no plannedPathRecords) is never scanned and produces neither a path nor a blind spot. The basis can therefore call the discovery profile complete while an omitted C2 outside that preselected registry closure is invisible; F-001's independent discovery requirement remains unresolved.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by f4de47a239: discovery no longer starts from the planned/process-fact closure. Scope obligations, full PROCESS_FACT_REGISTRY candidates, command-catalog plus exact registry.registerBatch handler dispatches, static producer/consumer source inspection, and RUNTIME_FACT_REGISTRY are independently enumerated. Current-HEAD smoke deletes real dispatch registration and adds comment-only/token-mismatch controls; both fail partial before restored control passes.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/acceptance-coverage-basis.ts:339-348 enforces topology mapping only for planned: and path:existing: entries. Paths actually emitted by the repaired registry/runtime adapters use path:process-fact: and path:runtime-fact:, so they bypass AT_UNMAPPED_SCOPE_REF entirely; the reverse topology loop also cannot map those encodings. A globally discovered consumer can therefore remain absent from topology/exclusions without making the basis partial, contrary to the required registered-consumer closure invariant.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by f4de47a239: reconciliation normalizes and maps every discovered encoding, including process-fact and runtime-fact paths, in both basis-to-topology and topology-to-basis directions. Current-HEAD unmapped process/runtime consumer and reverse omission mutations produce AT_UNMAPPED_SCOPE_REF/AT_TOPOLOGY_OUTSIDE_BASIS; restored mappings pass.

findings.desc: doc-promise-undelivered: packages/main/src/core/acceptance-discovery-adapters.ts:117-143 and :164-171 still do not mechanically verify handler/dispatch registration. handlerInspectable marks every producerSourceRef inspectable when each file contains any generic entry token; for acceptance_basis_generate, registry.ts can continue matching proofstory/acceptance-basis comments or imports even after registry.registerBatch(createProofStoryHandlers(ctx)) is deleted. The adapter then emits the registered process-fact path and can agree with the registry adapter, so a real dispatch omission can remain complete. The current smoke only mutates an already-built result to empty and never deletes the real dispatch registration. Parse/resolve the canonical registry/command-to-handler binding (or fail partial) and add a production-source omission mutation.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by f4de47a239: handler/dispatch inspectability requires exact command-catalog name, exact registry.registerBatch(createProofStoryHandlers(ctx)) binding and exact proofstory handler method, not generic token presence. Current-HEAD production-source dispatch deletion and comment/import token decoys fail; restored registration passes.

findings.desc: doc-promise-undelivered: packages/main/src/core/acceptance-discovery-adapters.ts:131-134 and :172-179 contradict the Wave 1A PLAN semantics for genuinely new endpoints. plannedInspectable requires every declared producer/consumer symbol to already occur in a source file, and static_call_graph turns any not-yet-created PLAN endpoint into a blind spot; deriveAcceptanceCoverageBasis then classifies the basis partial. The plan and CHK-004 explicitly require a valid frozen planned declaration to enter a complete PLAN basis even when symbols do not yet exist. The smoke writes producer.ts/consumer.ts before deriving and therefore misses this case. Treat valid in-scope planned declarations as structural PLAN obligations without requiring implementation symbols, while preserving pre-REVIEW actual reconciliation for Wave 3, and add a no-files-yet PLAN control.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by f4de47a239: valid frozen in-scope planned declarations are structural PLAN obligations and no longer require not-yet-created files/symbols, while registered/existing actual discovery remains independently inspected. Current-HEAD no-files-yet PLAN control completes and invalid/unresolved declarations still fail closed.

findings.desc: CHK-002 evidence remains incomplete after F-008 repair. packages/main/src/tasks/proofstory-acceptance-basis-smoke.ts:169-181 and 200-216 cover cardinality, path/digest, one disagreement, and closure omission, but VI-A32A-002-PROFILE-TOTALITY and VI-A32A-002-RESULT-AND-CLOSURE-TAMPER also require invalid coverage claim, provenance, blind spot, and asymmetry-policy cases plus proof that caller discoveryMethods cannot narrow the registered profile. The current smoke contains no discoveryMethods case and only changes pathRefs/one coverageClaim optimism case, so two must intents are still semantically under-covered.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by f4de47a239: current-HEAD matrix now bites invalid coverage claim, provenance, blindSpot completeness, asymmetry kind/policyRef/scopeRefs and caller discoveryMethods narrowing; shuffled registered results remain canonical. Each mutation asserts its intended partial/error and restored control passes.

findings.desc: CHK-003 caller/freshness evidence remains incomplete after F-009 repair. The forbidden-field matrix at packages/main/src/tasks/proofstory-acceptance-basis-smoke.ts:333-345 omits receiptRef, basisDigest, issuer identity, signature, and the individual binding-hash fields explicitly required by VI-A32A-003-CALLER-ISSUER-FORGERY. The receipt mutation matrix proves signed tamper rejection, but VI-A32A-003-FRESHNESS-CLASSIFICATION separately requires headHash-only and unrelated-material movement to be classified by the existing freshness reader and never silently rebound; no such classification controls exist. Thus the two recorded pass rows still overclaim their must intents.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by f4de47a239 plus b926319a11/9fb0dd5f24 contract correction: both public strict schemas and direct handlers reject receiptRef, basisDigest, issuer/signature and every individual binding hash in addition to inventory fields. Current-HEAD freshness controls classify head-only and unrelated-material/storyFilesHash-unchanged movement through the canonical reader without rebinding or artifact mutation.

findings.desc: CHK-005 evidence remains incomplete after F-010 repair. VI-A32A-005-LEGACY-UNSUPPORTED-DETERMINISM requires real-CLI legacy-missing, partial, and unsupported cases plus shuffled-equivalent adapter inputs; the smoke has real legacy/partial paths but unsupported only at the pure reconciliation layer and no shuffled adapter-order replay. VI-A32A-005-READONLY-DIAGNOSTIC-BOUNDARY requires rendered output to be rejected when replayed as gate evidence/authority, not merely labeled non-evidentiary. VI-A32A-005-PROCESS-FACT-CONTRACT requires omission/one-sided prompt, handler, registry, or contract registration mutations, while lines 475-487 exercise only drop-acceptance-basis-registry. Three must evidence rows therefore remain incomplete.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by f4de47a239, 9fb0dd5f24 and b926319a11: current-HEAD production CLI covers legacy missing/partial/unsupported and shuffled deterministic replay; diagnostic output is rejected as authority; prompt/handler/registry/contract one-sided mutations each fail then restored contract passes. Prompt side is the lattice-implementer sole-writer/read-only/non-authority boundary; writer command/artifact are L3 non-gate, explicitly preventing Wave2 enforcement.

findings.desc: doc-promise-undelivered: packages/main/src/core/acceptance-discovery-adapters.ts:61-84 and :182-195 leave F-011 unresolved. handler_dispatch_inventory and static_call_graph independently perform exact checks only after relevantProcessFacts filters PROCESS_FACT_REGISTRY by terms copied from plannedPathRecords; neither adapter enumerates checklist/scope source files or discovers handlers/consumers absent from that preselected registry subset. Therefore an unregistered real handler/consumer C2, or a Story with no plannedPathRecords, yields no path and no blind spot and can still classify complete. Exact validation of known entries fixed F-013 but is not independent enumeration. Build a bounded source inventory from canonical checklist/scope files, enumerate handler/dispatch/static relations independently of topology/planned terms, union with registered closure, and add a real undeclared/unregistered C2 omission mutation.

doc-promise-undelivered: packages/main/src/core/acceptance-discovery-adapters.ts:67-72 and :135-195 still do not implement a general independently enumerated handler/dispatch/static discovery adapter. Candidate entries are restricted to PROCESS_FACT_REGISTRY rows keyword-matched from plannedPathRecords; the dispatch verifier is then hard-coded to command-catalog.ts, createProofStoryHandlers(ctx), and handlers/proofstory.ts. It neither scans signed scope/checklist source files for additional consumers nor follows each registry entry's actual owner/source refs, so non-ProofStory commands such as the plan's review_run_start example can never be confirmed while an unregistered extra consumer remains invisible rather than producing a blind spot. The owner claim that f4de47a239 enumerates full registry/scope candidates is not supported by the production source; F-011's generic Wave 1A discovery requirement remains incomplete.

doc-promise-undelivered: packages/main/src/core/acceptance-discovery-adapters.ts:106-181 builds its reverse-import universe only from signed scope seed files plus already-declared PROCESS_FACT_REGISTRY source refs. A consumer outside Story scope that is not already listed in producerSourceRefs/consumerSourceRefs is never scanned and creates no blind spot; reached entries also no longer fail partial when consumerGate exists but consumerSourceRefs is absent. The generic smoke at proofstory-acceptance-basis-smoke.ts:372-374 calls C2 external but explicitly adds packages/main/src/consumers/c2.ts to scopeRefs, so it does not prove the required outside-scope consumer closure. Removing that scope ref makes C2 invisible while the bounded discovery can remain complete. F-019/Wave 1A's global registered-consumer requirement is therefore still unresolved.

Canonical source-root inventory does not fail closed when an intermediate scanRoot/rootDir component is a symlink that escapes the workspace. configuredSourceInventory validates only the lexical resolve/relative result (lines 117-120) and lstatSync(absoluteRoot) on the final path (lines 121-128). lstat on /workspace/link/src follows the intermediate link, so with scanRoot=link, rootDir=src, and link -> /outside, the external /outside/src directory is accepted and enumerated as if canonical workspace source. No realpath containment or component-by-component symlink check exists. The added smoke covers only a missing root (lines 431-433), not malformed/escaping/root-symlink/unreadable roots. This violates the targeted F-020 repair requirement that escaping and symlinked canonical roots yield partial. Bind workspace and source-root realpaths, reject any root whose physical path escapes the physical workspace or traverses a symlink/ambiguous component, and add adversarial controls for parent-component symlink escape plus malformed, lexical escape, and unreadable roots.

The canonical source-root scan still does not establish an exact executable import-and-call edge. exactCalledImports and staticCallPaths strip comments and import declarations but leave string and template literal contents, then accept any alias followed by an opening parenthesis regex match (acceptance-discovery-adapters.ts:176-180, 308-312, 327-331). Therefore an outside-scope file that imports a producer but only contains a string such as const marker = consume( is added to the closure, emitted as a static-call path, and can satisfy discoveredConsumer even though it never calls the producer. Focused reproduction against the same stripping and matching algorithm printed {executableText: export const marker = consume(, classifiedAsCall:true}. The new smoke covers a real call, removal, unresolved import, and unrelated file, but has no string or template false-positive mutation (proofstory-acceptance-basis-smoke.ts:369-423). This leaves F-020 no-false-exclusion and exact-import-call condition open. Use syntax-aware call-expression binding or conservatively fail partial when the bounded parser cannot prove a call, and add a mutation where the alias appears only inside string or template text and must not enter closure or satisfy the consumer gate.
